compute_policy: local CPU/local GTX 1050 only; no HF cpu-upgrade, Jobs, paid, or remote compute
selection_rationale: Anchored six-claim contract; pinned arXiv source directly supplies closed-form Stein identity estimator and a deterministic local CPU formula fixture. Image-generation FID claims are deferred as non-CPU-feasible full benchmarks.

claim_1_outcome.scope: Deterministic one-dimensional Gaussian forward-coupling Monte Carlo evaluation of the exact source reference-free gamma formula versus direct MSE-optimal gamma. It preserves the formula and coefficient metric but is not end-to-end SteinDiff sampling/theorem validation.

claim_2_outcome.scope: Finite local CPU 1-D paired-particle execution of Theorem 4.8 exact-coefficient one-step MSE identity, trajectory product, and eta bound for a synthetic noisy affine candidate. It is not learned SteinDiff inference or a theorem verification.
